mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is low are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals economic weakness and imminent monetary policy easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand weakness, triggering expectations of aggressive monetary easing and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1% signals supply-side economic disruption, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) level signals persistent inflation, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL is high are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 (PAYEMS) signals an overheating labor market, triggering expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS change > 200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1300) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0) signals severe economic distress, driving aggressive monetary policy responses and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of HOUST < 1300 and UNRATE > 4.0 fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when INDPRO is high are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
